column1: # Direct (cross-linked) client proteins of the Hsp70 chaperone Ssa1: His-tagged Ssa1 expressed in an ssa1-4 deletion strain (all four SSA genes deleted), purified from DSSO cross-linked yeast cells, cross-link mass spectrometry (XL-MS)

# Nitika, Zheng B, Ruan L, et al. 2022. Comprehensive characterization of the Hsp70 interactome reveals novel client proteins and interactions mediated by posttranslational modifications. PLoS Biol 20(10):e3001839. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3001839
# Source: pbio.3001839.s005.xlsx (S1 Table), sheet "XL Ssa1-client peptides" (https://journals.plos.org/plosbiology/article/file?id=10.1371/journal.pbio.3001839.s005&type=supplementary)

# Cutoff: the paper's direct-interactor filter (cross-linked peptide pairs in which one peptide is Ssa1); 177 Ssa1-client cross-link rows (the paper's 177 inter-protein cross-links) on 147 client genes, all kept, one row per gene; "cross-links" = number of Ssa1-client rows for the gene in that sheet; "Position on Ssa1" = cross-linked Ssa1 residues as listed; bait added as row 1; "AI5," in the file is written AI5_BETA (its Name column)
